item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Manav's night-sky sketch. Pattern P is the Big Dipper, pattern Q is the Little Dipper, and star R is the Pole Star in the Little Dipper. He wants to find North.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Star R marks North because the Pole Star in the Little Dipper appears fixed in the North direction.
options.B: Pattern P marks North because the Pole Star belongs to the Big Dipper.
options.C: Star R marks North from every place on Earth, even where the Pole Star cannot be seen.
options.D: The brightest star in the sketch marks North, whether or not it is star R.
